publicSafeStatus: Summarised for prototype use. Do not publish private account ownership, raw admin notes, private subscription details or unreviewed committee material.

storyBeats.summary: The club has a governing constitution, administrative identity, banking setup, meeting records and an existing public website.
storyBeats.siteUse: Show that the platform is extending an existing club, not inventing one from scratch.

storyBeats.summary: Google Workspace, Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Forms, Calendar and Apps Script are already part of the intended operating stack.
storyBeats.siteUse: Frame GitHub Pages as the public layer fed by private Google-led operations.

storyBeats.summary: The club has active Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok channels, with stronger reach on Facebook than the newer channels.
storyBeats.siteUse: Show content and event stories as reusable public outputs across website and social channels.

storyBeats.summary: Membership, volunteers and committee bandwidth are the main growth constraints after a quiet period.
storyBeats.siteUse: Make onboarding, renewals, volunteering and prompt committee packs central to the design.

storyBeats.summary: The club wants better event wrap-ups, media workflows, map references, solunar planning, weather context and privacy-aware field summaries.
storyBeats.siteUse: Keep Field Ops visual, permission-aware and export-driven.

storyBeats.summary: The longer-range vision includes offline-first apps, catch logging, selective GPS sharing, conservation data, sponsor pins and future simulation-ready local data.
storyBeats.siteUse: Treat the current website as a simple demonstration layer that can grow into richer tools later.

operatingAssets: Content calendar and idea intake form
Moreton Bay fishing and conservation map references
priorityConstraints: Grow active membership and volunteer participation
Reduce secretary and committee admin load
Turn informal chat and document archives into clear action queues
Protect member privacy, precise GPS and unapproved media
Confirm account ownership, access groups and approval rules before live automation

backendImplications.role: Private vault for minutes, source documents, finance exports, raw media and permission evidence.
Structured ledgers for members, payments, events, permissions, media, actions, calendar queues and public exports.
Approved schedule layer for committee meetings, competitions, working bees, content deadlines and renewal cycles.
Inbound and outbound communication trail for renewals, notices, confirmations, sponsor contact and permission requests.
Public-safe storytelling and visualisation layer, never the private source of truth.
